name: Tariq Volkov-Achebe
location: The Circuit, near North Ave and Damen

physical_description.build: Athletic with thickening through the torso — the build of someone who was lean in his thirties but has settled into middle age without letting himself go. Broad shoulders, defined forearms.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper black with premature silvering at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and neat, faded on the sides, slightly longer on top — functional but considered
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertones
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep complexion with warm undertones; West African heritage dominant in facial structure, Slavic in bone density
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but maintained — clean-shaven jaw with subtle scarring along the left jawline from old trauma. Crow's feet suggest frequent squinting or chronic stress. Skin texture is weathered but not neglected; faint chemical scars on knuckles suggest deliberate removal of identifying marks.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 8cm along the left jawline, from corner of mouth toward ear — surgical or blade work
Tattoo on inner left wrist: faded Cyrillic text (approximately 3x2cm, blue-black ink, aged 20+ years)
Burn scar across the dorsum of right hand, third-degree old injury, partially faded with subcutaneous replacement tissue
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None obvious at first glance. Subtle tells: pupils dilate/contract unnaturally in low light (subdermal neural interface), faint silver nodes visible at the base of the skull when hair is short (data port array). Occasional micro-tremor in right hand suggests neural optimization hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced, always angled to keep both exits in peripheral vision. Handshake is firm but controlled. Speaks quietly, forcing others to lean in; listens more than talks. Eyes track fast movement on instinct.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 hybrid: expensive basics over cheaper layers. Usually wears tailored grey or charcoal wool trousers, neutral-tone merino undershirt, tactical overshirt or unbranded tech-weave jacket (water-resistant, micromesh pockets). Hiking boots — practical, durable, good ankle support. One silver chain bracelet (family heirloom, kept). No visible logos. Everything is functional; nothing screams wealth or status. Wears a weathered leather wrist cuff on left arm with embedded RFID reader (for safe houses).
